title: Percolation

title: Elephant Flatten
comment: Elephant Flatten — Surface parameterization computes a diffeomorphism between a 3-D surface and a "simple" domain. Here parameterizing an elephant on a sphere and half an elephant on a disk. http://sites.fas.harvard.edu/~cs277/handouts/param.pdf

title: Bernoulli

title: Newton Lagrange
comment: Newton Lagrange — The dynamics of a system of rods (multiple pendulums) is an ODE evolution on a 2nd-order algebraic variety. Defines highly complex patterns as soon as n 2. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Double_pendulum
alt_text: Newton Lagrange. The dynamics of a system of rods (multiple pendulums) is an ODE evolution on a 2nd-order algebraic variety. Defines highly complex patterns as soon as n 2.

title: Mean Curv
comment: Mean Curv — The mean curvature motion is the most fundamental curve evolution. Equivalent for curves of the heat equation. Independent of parameterization, minimizes the length of the curve. Shrinks the curves toward an ellipse. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Curve-shortening_flow
alt_text: Mean Curv. The mean curvature motion is the most fundamental curve evolution. Equivalent for curves of the heat equation. Independent of parameterization, minimizes the length of the curve. Shrinks the curves toward an ellipse.

title: Gouraud
comment: Gouraud — Classic reference: Henri Gouraud, Continuous shading of curved surfaces, 1971. Gouraud shading is the basic method to render illuminated surfaces by interpolation. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gouraud_shading
alt_text: Gouraud. Classic reference: Henri Gouraud, Continuous shading of curved surfaces, 1971. Gouraud shading is the basic method to render illuminated surfaces by interpolation.

title: Slerp

title: Softmax

title: Lyapounov
